projects.name: RootMap
projects.label: Current focus
projects.summary: A calm, Montessori-inspired companion for parents of young children.
projects.description: A calm, Montessori-inspired companion for parents of young children. Each day it suggests a hands-on activity suited to your child’s age, and lets you save small moments that build into a record of how they grow. Available in English and 简体中文, on web and iOS.

images.alt: RootMap on a phone: the Today screen, with a welcome card and today’s inspiration, Matching Socks.

projects.name: Truvit
projects.summary: Helping organizations turn their content libraries into AI models for better operations and personalized training.
projects.description: Truvit helps businesses and education organizations convert their datasets and book/content libraries into AI models that improve operations and deliver personalized training.

projects.name: Peninsula Montessori Lessons
projects.label: Mini Project 1
projects.summary: Searchable circle-time lesson plans for busy preschool teachers.
projects.description: A mobile-friendly site that helps busy preschool teachers search and filter circle-time lesson plans by each child’s interests, so personalized lessons take less prep time.

images.alt: Peninsula Montessori Lessons on a phone: lesson search with age, topic and area filters, and popular activities such as Cleaning Mirror.

projects.name: Lesson Prep Planner
projects.label: Mini Project 2
projects.summary: A planning tool for Montessori classroom teachers.
projects.description: A planning tool for Montessori classroom teachers: schedule practical-life activities onto dates, check off materials as they’re ready, and see how much prep time each day needs.

images.alt: Lesson Prep Planner on a phone: a form to schedule an activity, and an overview of prep time.

projects.name: Cookie Bytes by Julia
projects.label: Collaboration
projects.summary: Julia Cook’s books, videos and activities, brought together for parents and teachers.
projects.description: A platform that brings Julia Cook’s books, videos, and activities together, helping parents and teachers understand children’s behaviors and find simple ways to support them.

images.alt: Cookie Bytes by Julia on a phone: “Real help for real moments,” with a search box and example topics such as Getting angry.
